def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    # Full-width / full-height divider lines are color 3.
    row_divs = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 3 for v in grid[r])]
    col_divs = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 3 for r in range(h))]
    row_bounds = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    col_bounds = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    row_spans = [(row_bounds[i] + 1, row_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(row_bounds) - 1)]
    col_spans = [(col_bounds[i] + 1, col_bounds[i + 1]) for i in range(len(col_bounds) - 1)]
    # Find the panel containing the pattern: colors other than its uniform background.
    panels = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
            marks = [(r-r0, c-c0, grid[r][c]) for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1) if grid[r][c] != bg]
            panels.append((len(marks), ri, ci, r0, r1, c0, c1, bg, marks))
    _, sri, sci, sr0, sr1, sc0, sc1, bg, marks = max(panels, key=lambda p: p[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(row_spans):
        for ci, (c0, c1) in enumerate(col_spans):
            if (ri, ci) == (sri, sci):
                continue
            for dr, dc, value in marks:
                if r0 + dr < r1 and c0 + dc < c1:
                    out[r0 + dr][c0 + dc] = value
    return out

        col_divs = [c for c in col_divs if grid[0][c] == divider]
    rb = [-1] + row_divs + [h]
    cb = [-1] + col_divs + [w]
    rs = [(rb[i] + 1, rb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(rb) - 1)]
    cs = [(cb[i] + 1, cb[i + 1]) for i in range(len(cb) - 1)]

    # The panel containing the motif is the one with the most cells unlike its background.
    panels = []
    for ri, (r0, r1) in enumerate(rs):

            vals = [grid[r][c] for r in range(r0, r1) for c in range(c0, c1)]
            bg = max(set(vals), key=vals.count)
